title: Seventh Collected Coin Awards Zero Score
explanation: At frame 477 (t=8.45s), collecting the 7th coin (coin_id: 60783855318) at (3800, 700) awarded 0 score. Traced to Coin.gd:L63-L71 where total_coins_collected == 7 overrides should_award_score to false, violating the contract that collectibles award their defined score value.
